description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and Eval PPL for different models. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio in percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 100 to 25, and tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, also on a linear scale, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares four models: Transformer, Only MoHD FFN, Only MoHD ATTN, and MoHD ATTN + MLP, represented by red dashed, grey solid with square markers, dark blue dashed, and blue solid with cross markers lines, respectively. The Transformer line remains steady at approximately 11.6 across the x-axis. The Only MoHD FFN line starts at around 11.6 at 100% Activated Parameters Ratio, decreases to about 11.4 at 50%, and then increases to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The Only MoHD ATTN line begins at around 11.6 at 100%, remains relatively stable until 50%, and then sharply increases to about 14.3 at 25%. The MoHD ATTN + MLP line starts at approximately 11.6 at 100%, remains steady until 50%, and then rises to around 13.2 at 25%.
